propositions: Code-v3 impact model discards verifier-answered prod_impact and trigger_likelihood fields when scoring test findings in the maintainability lane, causing load-bearing findings (prod=medium/high) to score ~0.30 despite valid user-reach signals, staying below the 0.95 advisory threshold.

Contract-contradicting assertions (a test forbidding a state the same diff's contract allows) are not detected by Pass-1's refactor-based change detector antipattern, missing the core failure mode exemplified by commit 8eadb4fbc5.

The maintainability lane's churn-dampening formula (×0.5 when churn90 absent on 80% of findings) compresses scores and prevents test findings from reaching blocking thresholds even when prod_impact and trigger_likelihood justify blocking.

The code-v4 model must split the maintainability lane by consequence tier, apply prod_impact/trigger_likelihood keying to moderate-consequence binaries, restrict reversibility floor to consequence lanes only, and make churn an amplifier-only factor for debt binaries.
The tests criterion must be flipped from advisory@0.95 to blocking@0.54 after the impact model repair, to enforce the recalibrated scores.

Version bump and routing change require updates to hard-equality consumers: IMPACT_MODEL_VERSION pins, blocking-set pins in test_impact_model_versioning.py and test_code_review_ws2.py, and impact_code v4 arithmetic verification in test_impact_code.py.
